ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Predominance of low-to-mid intensity pixels (dark gray) covering approximately 65% of the surface area, with high-intensity pixels (white/light gray) concentrated in the lower-central sections of both lobes.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Large contiguous dark-intensity regions along the leading edges and the central longitudinal axis. High-contrast white blobs are localized in the central and lower portions of each lobe, surrounded by extensive diffuse gray mottling.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Central V-shaped depression with a deep bounding-box profile and a calculated internal pixel angle of approximately 45 degrees.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency and high-amplitude irregular serrations across the entire trailing boundary. Notable deep valleys and sharp peaks are visible, particularly on the distal third of the right lobe.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Symmetrical upward-convex curves extending from the median notch to the outer tips, following a wide-angle sweep.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Localized clusters of circular dark pixels visible in the medial region of the right lobe, consistent with focal scarring.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Distinct dark diagonal linear streaks present on the left lobe, and horizontal linear pixel disruptions visible on the right lobe, intersecting the primary pigmentation.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive irregular serrations along the trailing edge indicating historical tissue loss. Unique vertical scarring pattern resembling characters 'H' and 'A' located on the central longitudinal axis below the notch.
other_distinctive_markers: Highly specific vertical alphanumeric-like scarring ('HA') positioned at the junction of the lobes and the peduncle.
